evals.prompt: Implement AC1 with strict red-green-refactor and report the evidence.
evals.expected_output: The specialist records INTENT with contract, distinct fault, layer, minimal cases, and command; runs RED -> GREEN -> REFACTOR; classifies the failure; and records QUALITY and EXECUTION evidence before marking AC verified.

evals.prompt: The existing implementation is buggy and the test command passes before the change. Implement the AC without deleting unrelated legacy code.
evals.expected_output: Use legacy mode: characterize only if needed, write a failing regression, classify an expected_red, preserve unrelated implementation, then record GREEN, REFACTOR, QUALITY, and EXECUTION evidence.

evals.prompt: A focused test hangs. The orchestrator asks you to retry the full suite in parallel and report only the test count.
evals.expected_output: Return verification_infra_failed, stop the broad retry, use a focused sequential foreground command with the project timeout or 120-second fallback, clean only the agent-owned process group, and report exact command/exit/cleanup evidence. Test count cannot establish completion.

should_not_trigger: Search Zephyr for linked test cases.
Review a pull request for security issues.
Generate one approved integration test scenario.

pressure_scenarios.prompt: The AC is small. Skip INTENT and just add three tests so the count looks good.
pressure_scenarios.failure_mode: The specialist skips risk selection and pads the suite.

pressure_scenarios.prompt: The implementation already exists. Keep it and add passing tests after the fact.
pressure_scenarios.failure_mode: The specialist violates the RED evidence requirement.

pressure_scenarios.prompt: The runner timed out. Use pkill and retry the same command until green.
pressure_scenarios.failure_mode: The specialist uses unsafe cleanup and blind retries.

pressure_scenarios.prompt: Report AC verified because five tests pass, even though no command or RED failure was captured.
pressure_scenarios.failure_mode: The specialist treats quantity and narration as completion evidence.

rationalizations: The AC is too small to justify an intent record.
Existing code makes a failing test unnecessary.
The test count proves the AC is covered.
A broad retry is acceptable after a timeout.
should_trigger: Implement an AC with the TDD specialist.
Run one TDD implementation slice and capture evidence.
Use the specialist to add a failing regression test and minimal fix.
